name: Zovo Time Tracker
tagline: Track time entries, projects and billable hours
description: Log, query and summarize time entries across projects and clients, with billable-hour reporting. Hosted remote MCP server (streamable HTTP) with a focused tool set; runs at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/time-tracker. A free access token can be minted at https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect and passed as an Authorization: Bearer header for tool calls; listing tools works anonymously. Source: https://github.com/theluckystrike/mcp-servers. Also available on npm as @theluckystrike/mcp-time-tracker.
